title: Goat Cheese and Grape Salsa
description:
You might have already turned your nose up at the title of this recipe...but give me just half a minute to tell you that this salsa/dip, is not only different, but refreshing, bright, creamy, with nothing but flavor in every bite!
"Just a fun dip!" So fun, you'll want to double the recipe.
Everything is combined in one bowl - it's so colorful! Really truly, this one is a keeper and it will amaze you because it's got everything going on...crunchy, crispy, fresh, cool, peppery and then...then there's the creaminess of goat cheese!
ingredients: 2 tablespoons pepper jelly (homemade or store bought)
1/4 cup finely diced yellow bell pepper
directions: In a medium bowl, whisk together pepper jelly and lime juice.
Stir in grapes, bell pepper, green onions and cilantro.
Add goat cheese crumbles and stir, the cheese will begin to liquefy, with some pieces remaining.
Serve immediately or refrigerate, with crackers, baguette slices, chips, whatever.
